verification.title: Candidate verification queue
verification.description: Review candidate evidence against the profile entry it supports. Approve it, or reject it with a reason the candidate can act on.

dialog.title: Review candidate evidence
dialog.claimMissing: The linked profile entry was removed.
dialog.noInline: This file type can’t be shown here. Open it in a new tab to review it.
dialog.approveText: The check counts for the candidate's profile, and recruiters see a tick. The candidate gets an email.
dialog.rejectText: The candidate sees the reason by email and on the Verification page, and can send new evidence.
dialog.decidedNow: Decision saved and emailed to the candidate.

accounts.title: Account review queue
accounts.description: Approve, reject or suspend recruiter accounts after checking the company record and the KYC documents.
accounts.empty: No recruiter accounts with this status.

dialog.title: Review recruiter account
dialog.noActions: No decision is available for this account until the recruiter resubmits.

approved.title: Approve this recruiter?
approved.text: The recruiter workspace opens and the default pipeline stages are created. The recruiter gets an email.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this recruiter?
reactivate.text: The recruiter can sign in again and their published jobs return to candidates. The recruiter gets an email.

rejected.title: Reject this application?
rejected.text: The recruiter sees the reason by email and on the status page, and can fix the details and resubmit.

suspended.title: Suspend this recruiter?
suspended.text: The recruiter is signed out, their jobs disappear from candidates and they get an email with the reason.

dialog.reasonHint: Up to {{max}} characters. Recorded with the decision and in the audit log.
dialog.decidedNow: Decision saved and emailed to the recruiter.

title: Trust is an ongoing practice.
description: Review reported content, accounts, and candidate credentials with care, context, and a clear record of every decision.

content.title: Content moderation queue
content.description: Review reported jobs, candidate profiles, companies and messages. Reports are signals for human review, not automatic findings.
content.openedFromJobs: Opened by an admin from Jobs
content.notice: No automated verdict is available. Review the content in context. Restricting a job pauses and locks it; restricting a profile hides it from recruiter search. The owner is emailed.
content.noticeDismissOnly: Company and message reports can only be dismissed. To act, suspend the recruiter in Account review or restrict the candidate’s profile.

restrictText.job: The job is paused and locked: the recruiter sees your reason and cannot publish it again until the case is dismissed.
restrictText.candidate_profile: The profile is hidden from recruiter search until the case is dismissed. You can also remove the profile photo.

content.dismissText: The content stays as it is and the case is closed with your note.

liftText.job: The lock is removed; the job stays paused until the recruiter publishes it again. The recruiter is emailed.
liftText.candidate_profile: The profile is visible in recruiter search again. The candidate is emailed.

content.reasonHint: Recorded with the decision and in the audit log.
content.reasonRequired: Add a reason so the decision has a clear record.
content.reasonTooLong: Keep the reason to {{max}} characters or fewer.

reviews.title: User reviews
reviews.description: Reviews candidates and recruiters wrote about EU Jobs. Approved reviews appear on the public home page with the first name and last initial.

empty.pending: No reviews are waiting for approval.

reviews.reasonHint: The author sees this note in Settings and can edit the review.

done.approve: Review by {{name}} approved. It now shows on the home page.
